verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own docs and community reports show it can use multiple model backends: users can swap models, choose between open-source and closed models, run local Ollama or API-based models (including GPT-4o and Hugging Face), and the homepage lists "Dynamic Model Selection". However, the evidence never names Anthropic, Google or OpenRouter, and never documents switching models per agent or per conversation. missing for 10: explicit support for Anthropic/Google/OpenRouter providers, documented per-agent or per-conversation model switching, in-depth first-party provider docs.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

citations.quote: Swap models, configure permissions, set up custom agent workflows
choose between open-source and closed models
a no-fuss way to use LLMs both locally and via APIs
With Ollama, everything was automatically detected
